note: Philosophy note of the day. The run writes one note per edition (edition.philosophy) and appends {date, thinker, work, tradition} here so no thinker repeats within 30 days and no work within 90. `traditions` is the rotation; aim to touch each within a fortnight. Quotes are exact and from a named edition or translation; the gloss explains the idea in plain words; the `why` line may connect it to the day's edition or to a staff officer's work, as a question rather than a lesson.
